name: Deep South Floor Care
description: Deep South Floor Care has been in business locally since 2006. We offer a myriad of services, including all aspects of floor care, using the latest techniques and procedures. We only use the highest quality products from top manufacturers. We understand the demands of this rental and real estate market, and we strive to accommodate the needs of our clients. We are COMMITTED to excellent service. Your satisfaction is guaranteed- if you are not completely satisfied with our work, we will return at no charge to make the job right. We specialize in Carpet, Tile and Grout, Upholstery, Area Rugs, In-place Drapery cleaning, Carpet Repairs, and Stain Removal.
